# Techniek OpsBoard Pro V2

> Project delivery control for engineering teams: Kanban flow with real WIP limits, PMI/PMBOK earned
> value, A/E financial controls, and a PM Assistant that answers questions about live projects and
> cites the clause of the user's own procedure library that governs each answer.

Built by [Techniek Engineering](https://techniekengineering.com/). Accounts are individually
approved; a full demo runs in the browser with no sign-up and no data stored on a server.

## Pages

- [Overview](/): what the product does and the two ways in.
- [Live demo](/try): the complete interface on a seeded sample portfolio. Runs entirely in the
  browser — no account, no network calls, nothing saved.
- [Request an account](/request-access): form for requesting access. Reviewed individually.
- [Application](/app): the product itself. Requires an approved account and authentication.

## What it does

- [Kanban flow](/try): pull system with WIP limits, work-item aging, and bottleneck detection.
  Moves pass the same governance whether a person drags a card or the agent proposes it.
- [Earned value](/try): CPI, SPI, EAC, and variance derived from the work items, with source-system
  overrides when a P6 or ERMAS extract should take precedence. Metrics are computed, never typed.
- [A/E financial controls](/try): earned multiplier and contribution margin against a configurable
  target, rules of credit, integrated change control, and funded-value exposure.
- [PM Assistant](/try): scope a question to one project, several, or the whole portfolio. Answers
  are assembled from computed metrics and deterministic findings, paired with passages retrieved
  from the user's own procedure library. Every figure is checked against that evidence, every
  suggestion cites a clause or says plainly that none covers it, and conditions no procedure covers
  are reported as a gap register.

## Notes for agents and crawlers

- The demo at [/try](/try) is the best place to evaluate the product; it needs no credentials.
- [/app](/app) and all `/api/` routes are behind authentication and will not return content.
- Demo content is fictional. It is not real client or project data.
- Contact: [gregory@techniekengineering.com](mailto:gregory@techniekengineering.com)
